```{ojs}
//| echo: false
// Hjelpekode for kapittel 3: laster strukturdata og tegnefunksjoner fra spill/-mappa.
// Samme filer brukes av aminosyrespillet. Ikke slett denne cellen.
BKAA = {
  const last = (url) =>
    new Promise((ok, feil) => {
      const s = document.createElement("script");
      s.src = new URL(url, document.baseURI).href;
      s.onload = ok;
      s.onerror = () => feil(new Error("Fant ikke " + url));
      document.head.append(s);
    });
  if (!window.BKAA || !window.BKAA.tegn) {
    await last("../spill/aminosyredata.js");
    await last("../spill/aminosyrekjemi.js");
  }
  return window.BKAA;
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
// Små hjelpefunksjoner: norsk desimalkomma og en ladningsgraf (ladning mot pH).
aaKomma = (x, d = 2) => (typeof x === "number" ? x.toFixed(d) : String(x)).replace(".", ",").replace("-", "−")
aaFarger = ({ upolar: "#f4dca0", polar: "#b4dfcd", positiv: "#a9d0e6", negativ: "#f2c3b4", ekstra: "#dfe6ea" })
aaLadningsGraf = (fn, pH, pI, W = 420) => {
  const H = Math.round(W * 0.5), l = 38, r = 12, t = 12, b = 30;
  const pts = [];
  for (let p = 0; p <= 14.001; p += 0.1) pts.push([p, fn(p)]);
  const ys = pts.map((q) => q[1]);
  const y0 = Math.floor(Math.min(...ys, -1)), y1 = Math.ceil(Math.max(...ys, 1));
  const X = (p) => l + (p / 14) * (W - l - r);
  const Y = (q) => t + ((y1 - q) / (y1 - y0)) * (H - t - b);
  const sti = pts.map((q, i) => (i ? "L" : "M") + X(q[0]).toFixed(1) + " " + Y(q[1]).toFixed(1)).join("");
  let rutenett = "";
  for (let q = y0; q <= y1; q++)
    rutenett += `<line x1="${l}" x2="${W - r}" y1="${Y(q)}" y2="${Y(q)}" stroke="currentColor" stroke-opacity="${q === 0 ? 0.55 : 0.12}"/><text x="${l - 6}" y="${Y(q)}" dy="0.35em" text-anchor="end" font-size="11" fill="currentColor">${q > 0 ? "+" + q : q < 0 ? "−" + Math.abs(q) : "0"}</text>`;
  for (let p = 0; p <= 14; p += 2)
    rutenett += `<text x="${X(p)}" y="${H - 10}" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="currentColor">${p}</text>`;
  const q = fn(pH);
  return `<svg viewBox="0 0 ${W} ${H}" style="width:100%;max-width:${W}px;height:auto;display:block;margin:0 auto" role="img" aria-label="Netto ladning som funksjon av pH">
    ${rutenett}
    <line x1="${X(pI)}" x2="${X(pI)}" y1="${t}" y2="${H - b}" stroke="#3f8468" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="5 4"/>
    <text x="${X(pI) + 4}" y="${t + 10}" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="#3f8468">pI = ${aaKomma(pI, 1)}</text>
    <path d="${sti}" fill="none" stroke="#3d7ea6" stroke-width="2.6"/>
    <circle cx="${X(pH)}" cy="${Y(q)}" r="6" fill="#e0584d" stroke="#fff" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="${W / 2}" y="${H - 0}" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="currentColor" opacity="0.7">pH</text>
    <text x="10" y="${H / 2}" font-size="11" fill="currentColor" opacity="0.7" transform="rotate(-90 10 ${H / 2})" text-anchor="middle">netto ladning</text>
  </svg>`;
}
```
